strings.name: Yuval Noah Harari
strings.summary: Trained in history in Jerusalem and Oxford, Harari initially studied medieval and military history before Sapiens brought him to broad historical writing for general readers. Homo Deus, 21 Lessons for the 21st Century and Nexus bring technology, storytelling, information and power into public debate. His synthesis crosses disciplines, and scholars have questioned some generalizations and predictions; his interpretations should be distinguished from specialist findings and events that have actually occurred.
